_comment: On Air's Local hoops block, the parts no feed carries. scripts/gather_onair_sports.py copies this into all-day/data/onair-sports.json next to UVM's games (from data/sports.json) and the basketball leagues and pickup in data/clubs.json + data/groups.json. Every line was checked on the organiser's own page on the `checked` date; re-check before trusting a date. Research: reference/drafts/new-nine-2026-10/research/sports-sources-2026-10-22.md in the newsletter repo. A game here is {date (YYYY-MM-DD), time ('7:00pm'), vs, home (true/false), where}; past ones drop off by themselves.

teams.name: Burlington Revolution
teams.what: Burlington's new pro team in the American Basketball Association, first season this winter. Home games at Burlington High School, streamed free on NSN.

teams.name: Vermont Coyotes
teams.what: Vermont's other ABA team, in Barre. This is their last season at the Barre Auditorium; home games start in December.

play.name: UVM Campus Rec community membership
play.what: Anyone can join UVM's rec center: open-rec basketball on the indoor courts.
play.cost: $45 a month + $25 to start, or $12 a day
